envelope.description: Add document-channel scratch-save / scratch-saved message contract in scratch-panels.ts

body.title: Add document-channel scratch-save / scratch-saved message contract in scratch-panels.ts
body.summary: Add the new document-channel protocol in vscode-plugin/src/panels/scratch-panels.ts: the scratch-save/scratch-saved message types with their const arrays, leaving the chat-channel protocol.ts unions untouched; pin direction isolation and gen carriage in scratch-panel.test.ts / protocol.test.ts.
acceptanceChecks: ScratchDocWebviewToHost gains { type: 'scratch-save'; id; gen; text } and ScratchDocHostToWebview gains { type: 'scratch-saved'; id; gen; ok; error? } in scratch-panels.ts, each with its own const array (SCRATCH_DOC_WEBVIEW_TO_HOST_TYPES / SCRATCH_DOC_HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES)
chat-channel protocol.ts unions/arrays are untouched (direction isolation asserted in the panel/protocol tests)
both messages carry gen so the reply is generation-guarded end to end
scratch-panel.test.ts asserts 'scratch-save' is only webview→host and 'scratch-saved' only host→webview

tests.name: scratch-panel.test.ts: 'scratch-save' in SCRATCH_DOC_WEBVIEW_TO_HOST_TYPES and NOT in SCRATCH_DOC_HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES; 'scratch-saved' in SCRATCH_DOC_HOST_TO_WEBVIEW_TYPES and NOT in SCRATCH_DOC_WEBVIEW_TO_HOST_TYPES; both carry gen; the chat-channel protocol.ts unions/arrays are untouched (direction isolation per channel)
